mutants.name: a trapped SFENCE.VMA flushes the TLBs
a head that does not commit flushes the TLBs (incomplete, an interrupt, a debug entry)
mutants.new: assign o_sfence    = i_head_valid && i_head_entry.complete && is_sys && (i_head_ctrl.sys_op == QV_SYS_SFENCE_VMA) && !faulted;

mutants.name: an incomplete head flushes the TLBs
any system operation flushes the TLBs
FENCE.I flushes the TLBs too
mutants.new: assign o_sfence    = commit && is_sys && (i_head_ctrl.sys_op == QV_SYS_SFENCE_VMA || i_head_ctrl.sys_op == QV_SYS_FENCE_I) && !faulted;

mutants.name: MRET flushes the TLBs
mutants.new: assign o_sfence    = commit && is_sys && (i_head_ctrl.sys_op == QV_SYS_SFENCE_VMA || i_head_ctrl.sys_op == QV_SYS_MRET) && !faulted;

mutants.name: WFI flushes the TLBs
mutants.new: assign o_sfence    = commit && is_sys && (i_head_ctrl.sys_op == QV_SYS_SFENCE_VMA || i_head_ctrl.sys_op == QV_SYS_WFI) && !faulted;

mutants.name: the SYS class is not required (redundant: a neutralized head, the only one with a sys_op outside its class, is a trap or a debug entry)
an SFENCE.VMA in a Program Buffer run does not flush
